description: Update a proof you own: title, tags, and visibility (public|unlisted|private). Setting visibility to private revokes public access, so confirm before making an already-shared proof private. Or leave feedback on an accessible proof. Send one kind of change per call: metadata, vote, or comment. Owners can vote on their own proofs. Delegated agents need manage_proofs.

addTags.description: Exact retrieval tag values to add. Keep descriptive prose in the title or proof body.

comment.description: Add a comment to this proof. Comments are visible according to proof privacy and access.

disclosePortableProof.description: Allow the full portable envelope on anonymous exact-qHash reads when this proof is public. Default false.

parentId.description: Optional parent comment ID when replying.

removeTags.description: Exact existing tag values to remove.

title.description: New title. Omit to keep, null to clear.

visibility.description: Proof visibility. public = discoverable, unlisted = link-only, private = owner-only. Omit to leave unchanged. Only the owner's own session can change it; a job run cannot.

vote.description: Upvote, downvote, or clear your vote on this proof. Proof owners can vote on their own proofs.

walletAddress.description: Optional owner wallet. Omit when signed in to use the current account.

name: proofable_proofs_update
title: Update proof
